name: Fetch JWKS for PostgREST
description: Fetches the OIDC JWKS document (Zitadel /oauth/v2/keys by default) and writes it to the postgrest `jwks` volume. PostgREST reads this file at startup via PGRST_JWT_SECRET=@/etc/postgrest/jwks/jwks.json. Skipped when pgrst_jwks_url is empty (PostgREST then runs without JWT validation). Re-runs on reconfigure to pick up Zitadel key rotation.
